reason: A DSH host plugin that inserts a user choice gate when the agent triggers a skill, allowing selection among described candidates with timeout-based fallback to the system default.

summaries.zh: 在智能体触发技能时展示候选技能供用户选择，并在超时后自动继续使用系统默认技能。
summaries.en: Adds a user choice gate for agent skill triggers, presenting described candidates and falling back to the system default after a timeout.

capabilities: Presents candidate skills through a user question UI
Allows the user to select an alternative skill
Falls back to the requested default skill after a configurable timeout
Injects a synthetic instruction for the selected skill
